message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and my kids thought it was the best thing ever. They grabbed their flashlights and turned the living room into a fort, while I scrambled to find our power bank to keep my phone charged just in case. As I sat there, I realized how much fun we could have, even without the usual screens. It was a great reminder that being prepared can turn a little chaos into a cozy adventure. Anyone else had a fun blackout moment recently?
